content.title: The Boys Season 5 Episode 3: Release Date, Time, Where To Watch And All You Need To Know
content.text: Photo source: X/@TheBoysTV The much-awaited final season of The Boys is already keeping fans hooked, and now all eyes are on Episode 3. After a gripping start, the next episode promises to take the story forward with even more intensity and surprises.What Happened In Episodes 1 And 2?In Episode 1 of The Boys Season 5, Homelander tightens his grip with brutal "Freedom Camps" while Starlight leads a struggling resistance. Her attempt to expose him is quickly buried, and a risky rescue mission leads to a violent clash. In the end, A-Train sacrifices himself to save Hughie, marking a powerful moment of redemption.In Episode 2 of The Boys Season 5, the team tests a deadly supe virus despite growing moral conflict within the group. The mission spirals when Soldier Boy tracks them down, leading to a violent clash. The virus proves effective, seemingly killing him and other supes. However, a final twist reveals Soldier Boy is still alive.What To Expect In Episode 3?With Homelander gaining more control and Butcher moving ahead with a dangerous plan, Episode 3 is expected to dive deeper into the growing conflict. The survival of Soldier Boy could change everything, and the battle between Supes and humans is only getting more intense.Video Player is loading.Current Time 0:00Duration 3:35Remaining Time 3:35 The Boys Episode 3 Release Date And TimeThe Boys Season 5 Episode 3, "Every One of You Sons of Bitches," will release on April 15, 2026, on Amazon Prime Video. The premiere goes live across India from 12:30 p.m. Indian Standard Time.The Boys Season 5: Full Episode ScheduleNew episodes are being released every Wednesday, leading up to the finale on May 20.Episode 1 & 2 – April 8 (Out Now)Episode 3 – April 15Episode 4 – April 22Episode 5 – April 29Episode 6 – May 6Episode 7 – May 13Episode 8 – May 20The Boys Season 5 CastThe final season features a strong ensemble cast including Karl Urban, Jack Quaid, Antony Starr, Erin Moriarty, Jessie T.
